lines: Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said to his people: "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
Not "I earned it." Not "I am great." Evident bounty: a gift, from Allah.
Remember those words. Because later in this film, a man who was given wealth will say the opposite... and we will see where each one ended.
And so his army gathered: "And gathered for Sulaiman were his soldiers of the jinn, and men, and birds, and they were marching in rows."
One day, that army marched toward a valley... and one tiny ant spoke.
